tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi chos skor la slob tshul don gnyer kun dga' bzhugs// na mo badzra dha ra buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir don gnyer can gyi rang gi slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi thun mong ba'i chos skor la slob tshul gyi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de yang skyes bu blo gsal zhing bla mas ji skad smras pa la nyan pa zhig rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi gsung rab dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs thun mong ba tsam zhig slob par 'dod na/ lam 'di bzhin du bstan te/ thog mar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i bar blo'i rim pa dang mthun par byin la/ de nas chos rje pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga lung sbyor dang bcas pa'i theg chen sems kyi sdom pa phog de'i rjes su rje btsun rtse mo'i dbang chu dang / grol lam la brten pa'i dbang gong ma bskur tshul gyi yig chung dang / ne tshe sbal ston la gdams pa'i yi ge bzhin/ yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ de nyid kyi bye brag gis sku mched gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i yab yum gyi sgrub thabs bsgrub pa'i dam tshig tu bstan nas/ de'i rjes nyid la rje btsun gyi rtsa ltung 'khrul spong bstan pas bsrung ba'i dam tshig la 'dris par byas nas/ bza' ba'i dam tshig tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yi ge rje btsun khu dbon gyis mdzad pa bshad la/ de ltar dam tshig can gyis bsnyen pa thon nas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi yig cha rje btsun sku mched gnyis kyis mdzad pa bshad cing / gzhan don du dbang bskur dang / rab gnas bya dgos na 'di bzhin yin no zhes de gnyis kyi yig cha rtse mos mdzad pa 'chad do/ /de nas rgyud la thos bsam byed par 'dod pa la/ thog mar mdo rgyud thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs par bya ba'i phyir spyi rnam/

rang gi rgyud ngos gzung ba'i don du mtshan don/ rgyud gsum tshul ji lta bus 'chad pa'i bshad thabs kyi yi ge rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa bstan nas/ de'i rjes su rgyud kyi gzhung 'dzin du 'jug go /de nas lam gyi rim pa rags pa blo yul du chags na/ rgyud don bde lag tu brnyed par 'gyur bas rgyud gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing bstan dgos so/ /mngon par rtogs pa de dag kyang rgyud kyi skabs 'di dang 'dis bstan pa nges dgos pas/ rgyud gsum so so'i bsdus don la slob po de la lob pa dang / rdo rje'i tshig rnams kyi 'bru go dgos pas sku mched gnyis kyis btab pa'i mchan la slob bo/ /de la lob par gyur pa de'i tshe rgyud don mtha' dag bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir rjod byed 'dis/ brjod bya 'di/ bshad rgyud 'di dang bsdebs te/ tshul 'di ltar du bshad na mngon par rtogs pa 'dir 'gyur zhing / rdo rje'i tshig re re la yang bshad tshul 'di lta bu yod do zhes/ gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnad ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba yab sras gsum gyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad rnams bstan no/ /rnam bshad rnams su yang bri yis mi lang ba'i mtha' dpyad pa dang / zhal shes rnams go zhing nyams su blang ba'i phyir yab yum gyi bstod pa mchan rnam bshad dang bcas pa bstan cing / gtum mo'i mngon rtogs nyi shu rtsa dgu la sogs pa'i khrid ci rigs pa 'bog pa yin no/ /de dag gi don brtson pa chen pos nyams su blangs pas drod gsum rim gyis thob nas spyod pa byed pa 'byung la/ de'i dus kyi chas ston pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i chas drug gi yi ge bshad do/ /de ltar thun mong gi rnam gzhag 'di ni yig cha rnams la slob tshul go rim nges par bya ba'i phyir bstan pa yin la/ skal ldan gyi gang zag mos gus dang brtson 'grus bsam gyis mi khyab cing /

rtse gcig tu sgrub pa lhur len pa rnams la gsung ngag rin po che'i glegs bam pod ser ma nas 'byung ba bzhin go rim phyin ci ma log pa 'chad cing nyams su blang dgos te/ yi ge'i rnam grangs dkar chag bzhin la/ go rim gyi nges pa ni man ngag can gyi bla ma mnyes pa'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dges pa rdo rje'i thun mong gi /chos skor rnams la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul/ /don gnyer kun dga' zhes bya'i bstan bcos 'di/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /don gnyer slob mas bskul te mgyogs par bris/ /'di ni kho bos rang bzo ma yin te/ /rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun gyi/ /zin bris rnams nas 'byung bzhin bkod pa lags/ /'di brtsams dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /'gro kun dag pa'i zhing der 'dren gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi chos skor la slob tshul don gnyer kun dga'/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
